```{r setup-chunk}

# load libraries
library(lubridate)
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(highcharter)
library(tidyr)
library(extrafont)
library(extrafontdb)
library(systemfonts)
library(sysfonts)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(janitor)
library(shinyWidgets)
library(shiny)
library(EpiEstim)
library(shinyjs)
library(deSolve)

options(scipen = 999) # avoid scientific notations

extrafont::loadfonts() # load fonts available on system

# initialize reactive values
model_results <- reactiveVal(NULL)
current_model <- reactiveVal(NULL)
simulation_only <- reactiveVal(TRUE)
run_clicked <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
params_changed <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
previous_mode <- reactiveVal(NULL)
bootstrap_results <- reactiveVal(NULL)
real_data_ci <- reactiveVal(NULL)
dataset <- reactiveVal(NULL)

# date parsing function
parse_date <- function(x, formats = c("%d/%m/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y")) {
  for (fmt in formats) {
    parsed <- as.Date(x, format = fmt)
    if (all(!is.na(parsed) | x == "" | is.na(x))) return(parsed)
  }
  stop("Unable to parse dates with provided formats")
}

# switched to data.table::fread for faster reading and processing
observeEvent(input$file1, {
  req(input$file1)
  df <- fread(input$file1$datapath) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), trimws)) %>%
    clean_names() %>%
    mutate(
      date_of_exposure = parse_date(date_of_exposure),
      date_of_onset = parse_date(date_of_onset)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(date_of_onset))
  dataset(df)
})
```

```{r model-functions}

# differential equations

# SI model ODE
si_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dI <- beta * S * I / N
    list(c(dS, dI))
  })
}

# SIR model ODE
sir_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dI <- beta * S * I / N - gamma * I
    dR <- gamma * I
    list(c(dS, dI, dR))
  })
}

# SEIR model ODE
seir_ode <- function(time, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    dS <- -beta * S * I / N
    dE <- beta * S * I / N - sigma * E
    dI <- sigma * E - gamma * I
    dR <- gamma * I
    list(c(dS, dE, dI, dR))
  })
}

# model functions for simulated data
run_si_model <- function(N, beta, days, initial_S = NULL, initial_I = NULL) {

  times <- seq(0, days, by = 1)
  
  # ODE simulation
  init <- c(S = initial_S, I = initial_I)
  parameters <- c(beta = beta, N = N)
  sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = si_ode, parms = parameters)
  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date("2020-01-01") + time)
  
  return(sim_df)
}

run_sir_model <- function(N, beta, gamma, days, initial_S = NULL, initial_I = NULL, initial_R = NULL) {
  
  times <- seq(0, days, by = 1)
  
  # ODE simulation
  init <- c(S = initial_S, I = initial_I, R = initial_R)
  parameters <- c(beta = beta, gamma = gamma, N = N)
  sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = sir_ode, parms = parameters)
  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date("2020-01-01") + time)
  
  return(sim_df)
}

run_seir_model <- function(N, beta, sigma, gamma, days, initial_S = NULL, initial_E = NULL, initial_I = NULL, initial_R = NULL) {
  
  times <- seq(0, days, by = 1)
  
  # ODE simulation
  init <- c(S = initial_S, E = initial_E, I = initial_I, R = initial_R)
  parameters <- c(beta = beta, sigma = sigma, gamma = gamma, N = N)
  sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = seir_ode, parms = parameters)
  sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date("2020-01-01") + time)
  
  return(sim_df)
}

# model function for real vs. simulated scenario
run_real_model <- function(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL, N_override = NULL) {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  
  if (model_type == "SI") {
    start_date <- min(dataset$date_of_exposure, na.rm = TRUE)
    end_date <- max(dataset$date_of_exposure, na.rm = TRUE) + 5 # buffer period (to capture late recoveries)
    dates <- seq.Date(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
    times <- seq(0, length(dates) - 1, by = 1)
    
    # ODE simulation
    init <- c(S = N - 1, I = 1)
    parameters <- c(beta = beta, N = N)
    sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = si_ode, parms = parameters)
    sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
      mutate(Date = start_date + time)
    
    # real data processing
    infection_counts <- dataset %>%
      group_by(date_of_exposure) %>%
      summarise(new_infections = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = date_of_exposure) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_infections = 0))
    
    si_df <- data.frame(Date = dates) %>%
      left_join(infection_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      replace_na(list(new_infections = 0))
    
    si_df$S_real <- NA
    si_df$I_real <- NA
    si_df$S_real[1] <- N
    si_df$I_real[1] <- 0
    for (t in 2:length(dates)) {
      si_df$S_real[t] <- si_df$S_real[t-1] - si_df$new_infections[t]
      si_df$I_real[t] <- si_df$I_real[t-1] + si_df$new_infections[t]
    }
    
    # ensure non-negative counts
    si_df$S_real <- pmax(si_df$S_real, 0)
    si_df$I_real <- pmax(si_df$I_real, 0)
    
    # merge simulated and real
    sim_df <- sim_df %>%
      left_join(select(si_df, Date, S_real, I_real), by = "Date")
    
    return(sim_df)
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    start_date <- min(dataset$date_of_onset, na.rm = TRUE)
    end_date <- max(dataset$date_of_onset, na.rm = TRUE) + ceiling(1/gamma) + 5
    dates <- seq.Date(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
    times <- seq(0, length(dates) - 1, by = 1)
    
    # ODE simulation
    init <- c(S = N - 1, I = 1, R = 0)
    parameters <- c(beta = beta, gamma = gamma, N = N)
    sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = sir_ode, parms = parameters)
    sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
      mutate(Date = start_date + time)
    
    # real data processing
    onset_counts <- dataset %>%
      group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
      summarise(new_I = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = date_of_onset) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_I = 0))
    
    recovery_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(recovery_date = date_of_onset + ceiling(1/gamma)) %>% # uses the gamma parameter for recovery days
      group_by(recovery_date) %>%
      summarise(new_R = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = recovery_date) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_R = 0))
    
    sir_df <- data.frame(Date = dates) %>%
      left_join(onset_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      left_join(recovery_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      replace_na(list(new_I = 0, new_R = 0))
    
    sir_df$S_real <- NA
    sir_df$I_real <- NA
    sir_df$R_real <- NA
    sir_df$S_real[1] <- N
    sir_df$I_real[1] <- 0
    sir_df$R_real[1] <- 0
    for (t in 2:length(dates)) {
      sir_df$S_real[t] <- sir_df$S_real[t-1] - sir_df$new_I[t]
      sir_df$I_real[t] <- sir_df$I_real[t-1] + sir_df$new_I[t] - sir_df$new_R[t]
      sir_df$R_real[t] <- sir_df$R_real[t-1] + sir_df$new_R[t]
    }
    
    # ensure non-negative counts
    sir_df$S_real <- pmax(sir_df$S_real, 0)
    sir_df$I_real <- pmax(sir_df$I_real, 0)
    sir_df$R_real <- pmax(sir_df$R_real, 0)   
    
    # merge simulated and real
    sim_df <- sim_df %>%
      left_join(select(sir_df, Date, S_real, I_real, R_real), by = "Date")
    
    return(sim_df)
  } else if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    start_date <- min(dataset$date_of_exposure, na.rm = TRUE)
    end_date <- max(dataset$date_of_onset, na.rm = TRUE) + ceiling(1/gamma) + 5
    dates <- seq.Date(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
    times <- seq(0, length(dates) - 1, by = 1)
    
    # ODE simulation
    init <- c(S = N - 1, E = 0, I = 1, R = 0)
    parameters <- c(beta = beta, sigma = sigma, gamma = gamma, N = N)
    sim <- ode(y = init, times = times, func = seir_ode, parms = parameters)
    sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim) %>%
      mutate(Date = start_date + time)
    
    # real data processing
    exposure_counts <- dataset %>%
      group_by(date_of_exposure) %>%
      summarise(new_E = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = date_of_exposure) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_E = 0))
    
    onset_counts <- dataset %>%
      group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
      summarise(new_I = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = date_of_onset) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_I = 0))
    
    recovery_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(recovery_date = date_of_onset + ceiling(1/gamma)) %>%
      group_by(recovery_date) %>%
      summarise(new_R = n()) %>%
      rename(Date = recovery_date) %>%
      complete(Date = dates, fill = list(new_R = 0))
    
    seir_df <- data.frame(Date = dates) %>%
      left_join(exposure_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      left_join(onset_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      left_join(recovery_counts, by = "Date") %>%
      replace_na(list(new_E = 0, new_I = 0, new_R = 0))
    
    seir_df$S_real <- NA
    seir_df$E_real <- NA
    seir_df$I_real <- NA
    seir_df$R_real <- NA
    seir_df$S_real[1] <- N
    seir_df$E_real[1] <- 0
    seir_df$I_real[1] <- 0
    seir_df$R_real[1] <- 0
    for (t in 2:length(dates)) {
      seir_df$S_real[t] <- seir_df$S_real[t-1] - seir_df$new_E[t]
      seir_df$E_real[t] <- seir_df$E_real[t-1] + seir_df$new_E[t] - seir_df$new_I[t]
      seir_df$I_real[t] <- seir_df$I_real[t-1] + seir_df$new_I[t] - seir_df$new_R[t]
      seir_df$R_real[t] <- seir_df$R_real[t-1] + seir_df$new_R[t]
    }
    
    # ensure non-negative counts
    seir_df$S_real <- pmax(seir_df$S_real, 0)
    seir_df$E_real <- pmax(seir_df$E_real, 0)
    seir_df$I_real <- pmax(seir_df$I_real, 0)
    seir_df$R_real <- pmax(seir_df$R_real, 0)    
    
    # merge simulated and real
    sim_df <- sim_df %>%
      left_join(select(seir_df, Date, S_real, E_real, I_real, R_real), by = "Date")
    
    return(sim_df)
  }
}
```

```{r bootstrap-comparison-functions}

# bootstrap function for comparison table
bootstrap_comparison <- function(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL, n_boot = 10) {
  N <- nrow(dataset)
  boot_stats <- replicate(n_boot, {
    boot_sample <- dataset[sample(nrow(dataset), replace = TRUE), ]
    if (model_type == "SI") {
      sim_df <- run_real_model(boot_sample, "SI", beta)
    } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
      sim_df <- run_real_model(boot_sample, "SIR", beta, gamma = gamma)
    } else {
      sim_df <- run_real_model(boot_sample, "SEIR", beta, sigma, gamma)
    }

    # calculate metrics for simulated data
    sim_peak <- max(sim_df$I, na.rm = TRUE)
    sim_duration <- as.numeric(max(sim_df$Date) - min(sim_df$Date))
    sim_infections <- tail(sim_df$I, 1)
    sim_peak_time <- as.numeric(sim_df$Date[which.max(sim_df$I)] - min(sim_df$Date))
    
    # calculate metrics for real data
    real_peak <- max(sim_df$I_real, na.rm = TRUE)
    real_duration <- as.numeric(max(sim_df$Date[!is.na(sim_df$I_real)]) -
                     min(sim_df$Date[!is.na(sim_df$I_real)]))
    real_infections <- tail(sim_df$I_real[!is.na(sim_df$I_real)], 1)
    real_peak_time <- as.numeric(sim_df$Date[which.max(sim_df$I_real)] - 
                      min(sim_df$Date[!is.na(sim_df$I_real)]))
    
    # calculate start times
    sim_start <- min(sim_df$Date[sim_df$I > 0])
    real_start <- min(sim_df$Date[!is.na(sim_df$I_real) & sim_df$I_real > 0])
    delayed_start <- as.numeric(real_start - sim_start)

    c(reduced_infections = round((real_infections - sim_infections), 0),
      reduced_duration = round((real_duration - sim_duration),0),
      reduced_peak = round((real_peak - sim_peak),0),
      delayed_peak = round((real_peak_time - sim_peak_time),0),
      delayed_start = round(delayed_start,0))
  })

  ci <- apply(boot_stats, 1, function(x) {
    quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  means <- rowMeans(boot_stats, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    Metric = c("Reduced Infections", "Reduced Duration (days)", "Reduced Peak",
              "Delayed Peak (days)", "Delayed Start (days)"),
    Estimate = round(means, 2),
    Lower_CI = round(ci[1, ], 2),
    Upper_CI = round(ci[2, ], 2)
  )
}

# bayesian parameter estimation using EpiEstim for R0 estimation
bayesian_estimate_params <- function(dataset, model_type, n_samples = 100, user_beta = NULL, user_sigma = NULL, user_gamma = NULL) {
  # estimate serial interval from data if available, else use defaults
  if ("date_of_exposure" %in% names(dataset) && "date_of_onset" %in% names(dataset)) {
    serial_intervals <- as.numeric(dataset$date_of_onset - dataset$date_of_exposure)
    serial_intervals <- serial_intervals[!is.na(serial_intervals) & serial_intervals > 0]
    
    if (length(serial_intervals) >= 5) {
      mean_si <- mean(serial_intervals)
      std_si <- sd(serial_intervals)
    } else {
      mean_si <- 7.5
      std_si <- 3.4
    }
  } else {
    mean_si <- 7.5
    std_si <- 3.4
  }
  
  # get incidence data
  incidence_data <- dataset %>%
    arrange(date_of_onset) %>%
    group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
    summarise(I = n()) %>%
    complete(date_of_onset = seq(min(date_of_onset), max(date_of_onset), by = "day"), 
             fill = list(I = 0))
  
  # use EpiEstim to estimate R0 with uncertainty
  if (nrow(incidence_data) >= 7) {
    tryCatch({
      n_days <- nrow(incidence_data)
      t_start <- 2
      t_end <- n_days
      
      R_estimates <- EpiEstim::estimate_R(
        incidence_data$I, 
        method = "parametric_si",
        config = EpiEstim::make_config(list(
          mean_si = mean_si, 
          std_si = std_si,
          n1 = 1000,
          n2 = 100,
          t_start = t_start,
          t_end = t_end
        ))
      )
      
      R0_samples <- sample(R_estimates$R$`Mean(R)`, n_samples, replace = TRUE)
      
      # use user-provided gamma or estimate from data
      if (!is.null(user_gamma)) {
        gamma <- user_gamma
      } else if ("date_of_onset" %in% names(dataset) && "recovery_date" %in% names(dataset)) {
        infectious_periods <- as.numeric(dataset$recovery_date - dataset$date_of_onset)
        infectious_periods <- infectious_periods[!is.na(infectious_periods) & infectious_periods > 0]
        gamma <- if (length(infectious_periods) >= 3) 1 / mean(infectious_periods) else 0.14
      } else {
        gamma <- 0.14
      }
      
      # use user-provided beta if provided, else derive from R0
      if (!is.null(user_beta)) {
        beta_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, user_beta, user_beta * 0.1)  # Add 10% noise
        beta_samples <- pmax(0.1, pmin(3.0, beta_samples))
      } else {
        beta_samples <- R0_samples * gamma
      }
      
      gamma_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, gamma, gamma * 0.2)
      gamma_samples <- pmax(0.05, pmin(0.5, gamma_samples))
      
      if (model_type == "SEIR") {
        if (!is.null(user_sigma)) {
          sigma_mean <- user_sigma
        } else if ("date_of_exposure" %in% names(dataset)) {
          incubation_periods <- as.numeric(dataset$date_of_onset - dataset$date_of_exposure)
          incubation_periods <- incubation_periods[!is.na(incubation_periods) & incubation_periods > 0]
          sigma_mean <- if (length(incubation_periods) >= 3) 1 / mean(incubation_periods) else 0.2
        } else {
          sigma_mean <- 0.2
        }
        sigma_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, sigma_mean, sigma_mean * 0.3)
        sigma_samples <- pmax(0.1, pmin(1.0, sigma_samples))
      } else {
        sigma_samples <- rep(0.2, n_samples)
      }
      
      return(list(
        beta_samples = beta_samples,
        gamma_samples = gamma_samples,
        sigma_samples = sigma_samples,
        R0_samples = R0_samples
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(fallback_param_estimation(dataset, model_type, n_samples, user_beta, user_sigma, user_gamma))
    })
  } else {
    return(fallback_param_estimation(dataset, model_type, n_samples, user_beta, user_sigma, user_gamma))
  }
}

# if insufficient sample size use this as a fallback

fallback_param_estimation <- function(dataset, model_type, n_samples = 100, user_beta = NULL, user_sigma = NULL, user_gamma = NULL) {
  total_cases <- nrow(dataset)
  
  beta_mean <- if (!is.null(user_beta)) user_beta else min(2.0, total_cases / 20)
  beta_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, beta_mean, beta_mean * 0.4)
  beta_samples <- pmax(0.1, pmin(3.0, beta_samples))
  
  gamma_mean <- if (!is.null(user_gamma)) user_gamma else 0.14
  gamma_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, gamma_mean, gamma_mean * 0.3)
  gamma_samples <- pmax(0.05, pmin(0.5, gamma_samples))
  
  sigma_mean <- if (!is.null(user_sigma)) user_sigma else 0.2
  sigma_samples <- rnorm(n_samples, sigma_mean, sigma_mean * 0.3)
  sigma_samples <- pmax(0.1, pmin(1.0, sigma_samples))
  
  R0_samples <- beta_samples / gamma_samples
  
  return(list(
    beta_samples = beta_samples,
    gamma_samples = gamma_samples,
    sigma_samples = sigma_samples,
    R0_samples = R0_samples
  ))
}

# function to run bayesian bootsrap estimates
run_bayesian_bootstrap_ci <- function(dataset, model_type, beta, sigma = NULL, gamma = NULL, n_boot = 10, N_override = NULL) {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  
  # use bayesian_estimate_params to generate parameter samples, respecting user inputs
  param_samples <- bayesian_estimate_params(dataset, model_type, n_samples = n_boot, 
                                           user_beta = beta, user_sigma = sigma, user_gamma = gamma)
  
  beta_samples <- param_samples$beta_samples
  gamma_samples <- param_samples$gamma_samples
  sigma_samples <- param_samples$sigma_samples
  
  # reference simulation using median of parameter samples
  ref_beta <- median(beta_samples, na.rm = TRUE)
  ref_gamma <- if (model_type %in% c("SIR", "SEIR")) median(gamma_samples, na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
  ref_sigma <- if (model_type == "SEIR") median(sigma_samples, na.rm = TRUE) else NULL
  
  reference_result <- if (model_type == "SI") {
    run_real_model(dataset, "SI", ref_beta, N_override = N)
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    run_real_model(dataset, "SIR", ref_beta, gamma = ref_gamma, N_override = N)
  } else {
    run_real_model(dataset, "SEIR", ref_beta, ref_sigma, ref_gamma, N_override = N)
  }
  
  reference_dates <- reference_result$Date
  n_days <- length(reference_dates)
  
  # run bootstrap simulations
  bootstrap_replicates <- list()
  valid_replicates <- 0
  
  for (i in 1:n_boot) {
    tryCatch({
      # add slight noise to initial conditions for SI model to ensure variability
      if (model_type == "SI") {
        boot_dataset <- dataset
        if ("date_of_exposure" %in% names(boot_dataset)) {
          # perturb exposure dates slightly
          boot_dataset$date_of_exposure <- boot_dataset$date_of_exposure + 
            sample(c(-1, 0, 1), nrow(boot_dataset), replace = TRUE)
        }
        result <- run_real_model(boot_dataset, "SI", beta_samples[i], N_override = N)
      } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
        result <- run_real_model(dataset, "SIR", beta_samples[i], 
                                gamma = gamma_samples[i], N_override = N)
      } else {
        result <- run_real_model(dataset, "SEIR", beta_samples[i], 
                                sigma_samples[i], gamma_samples[i], 
                                N_override = N)
      }
      
      # align with reference time frame
      result <- merge(data.frame(Date = reference_dates), result, by = "Date", all.x = TRUE)
      
      # fill missing values
      result <- result %>%
        fill(-Date, .direction = "down") %>%
        fill(-Date, .direction = "up")
      
      result[is.na(result)] <- 0
      bootstrap_replicates[[length(bootstrap_replicates) + 1]] <- result
      valid_replicates <- valid_replicates + 1
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Bootstrap iteration ", i, " failed: ", e$message)
    })
  }
  
  # check if enough valid replicates
  if (valid_replicates < 3) {
    warning("Insufficient valid bootstrap replicates (", valid_replicates, "). Using perturbed reference result.")
    bootstrap_replicates <- lapply(1:3, function(i) {
      perturbed <- reference_result
      perturbed$S <- pmax(0, perturbed$S + rnorm(nrow(perturbed), 0, N * 0.05))
      perturbed$I <- pmax(0, perturbed$I + rnorm(nrow(perturbed), 0, N * 0.05))
      if ("R" %in% names(perturbed)) perturbed$R <- pmax(0, perturbed$R + rnorm(nrow(perturbed), 0, N * 0.05))
      if ("E" %in% names(perturbed)) perturbed$E <- pmax(0, perturbed$E + rnorm(nrow(perturbed), 0, N * 0.05))
      perturbed
    })
    valid_replicates <- 3
  }
  
  # calculate quantiles for each compartment
  compartments <- c("S", "I", "R", "E")
  available_compartments <- intersect(compartments, names(bootstrap_replicates[[1]]))
  
  ci_results <- list()
  
  for (comp in available_compartments) {
    comp_data <- lapply(bootstrap_replicates, function(df) {
      df[[comp]]
    })
    
    comp_matrix <- do.call(cbind, comp_data)
    
    quantiles <- apply(comp_matrix, 1, function(x) {
      x_clean <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
      if (length(x_clean) >= 3) {
        quantile(x_clean, probs = c(0.025, 0.05, 0.125, 0.25, 0.75, 0.875, 0.95, 0.975), 
                na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
      } else {
        ref_vals <- reference_result[[comp]][1:length(x)]
        ref_vals + rnorm(length(ref_vals), 0, max(1, max(ref_vals, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.05))  # Add small noise
      }
    })
    
    ci_results[[comp]] <- as.data.frame(t(quantiles))
    names(ci_results[[comp]]) <- c("ci_2.5", "ci_5", "ci_12.5", "ci_25", "ci_75", "ci_87.5", "ci_95", "ci_97.5")
    ci_results[[comp]]$Date <- reference_dates
  }
  
  return(ci_results)
}

# get ci estimates by sampling real data
run_real_data_ci <- function(dataset, model_type, n_boot = 10, N_override = NULL, gamma = NULL) {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  
  if (is.null(dataset) || nrow(dataset) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (model_type == "SI") {
    exposures <- dataset$date_of_exposure[!is.na(dataset$date_of_exposure)]
    if (length(exposures) == 0) return(NULL)
    start_date <- min(exposures)
    end_date <- max(exposures) + 5
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    onsets <- dataset$date_of_onset[!is.na(dataset$date_of_onset)]
    if (length(onsets) == 0) return(NULL)
    start_date <- min(onsets)
    recovery_days <- if (!is.null(gamma)) ceiling(1 / gamma) else 7
    end_date <- max(onsets) + recovery_days + 5
  } else if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    exposures <- dataset$date_of_exposure[!is.na(dataset$date_of_exposure)]
    onsets <- dataset$date_of_onset[!is.na(dataset$date_of_onset)]
    if (length(exposures) == 0 || length(onsets) == 0) return(NULL)
    start_date <- min(exposures)
    recovery_days <- if (!is.null(gamma)) ceiling(1 / gamma) else 7
    end_date <- max(onsets) + recovery_days + 5
  }
  
  dates <- seq.Date(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
  all_dates <- dates
  
  ci_results <- list()
  
  for (comp in c("S", "E", "I", "R")) {
    comp_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(all_dates), ncol = n_boot)
    valid_count <- 0
    
    for (i in 1:n_boot) {
      tryCatch({
        case_ids <- sample(nrow(dataset), replace = TRUE)
        boot_sample <- dataset[case_ids, ]
        
        comp_counts <- calculate_compartment_counts(boot_sample, model_type, all_dates, N_override = N, gamma = gamma)
        
        comp_matrix[, i] <- comp_counts[[comp]]
        valid_count <- valid_count + 1
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Bootstrap iteration ", i, " failed: ", e$message)
        comp_matrix[, i] <- NA
      })
    }
    
    if (valid_count > 0) {
      quantiles <- apply(comp_matrix, 1, function(x) {
        x_clean <- x[!is.na(x) & is.finite(x)]
        if (length(x_clean) > 0) {
          quantile(x_clean, probs = c(0.025, 0.05, 0.125, 0.25, 0.75, 0.875, 0.95, 0.975), 
                  na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
        } else {
          rep(NA, 8)
        }
      })
      
      ci_results[[comp]] <- as.data.frame(t(quantiles))
      names(ci_results[[comp]]) <- c("ci_2.5", "ci_5", "ci_12.5", "ci_25", "ci_75", "ci_87.5", "ci_95", "ci_97.5")
      ci_results[[comp]]$Date <- all_dates
    } else {
      ci_results[[comp]] <- NULL
    }
  }
  
  if (all(sapply(ci_results, is.null))) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  return(ci_results)
}

# helper function to calculate compartment counts
calculate_compartment_counts <- function(dataset, model_type, dates, N_override = NULL, gamma = NULL) {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  results <- data.frame(Date = dates, S = NA, E = NA, I = NA, R = NA)
  
  dates <- as.Date(dates)
  
  recovery_days <- if (!is.null(gamma)) ceiling(1 / gamma) else 7
  
  if (model_type == "SI") {
    exposure_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(date_of_exposure = as.Date(date_of_exposure)) %>%
      group_by(date_of_exposure) %>%
      summarise(new_E = n()) %>%
      complete(date_of_exposure = dates, fill = list(new_E = 0))
    
    results$S <- N - cumsum(exposure_counts$new_E)
    results$I <- cumsum(exposure_counts$new_E)
    
  } else if (model_type == "SIR") {
    onset_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(date_of_onset = as.Date(date_of_onset)) %>%
      group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
      summarise(new_I = n()) %>%
      complete(date_of_onset = dates, fill = list(new_I = 0))
    
    recovery_data <- dataset %>%
      mutate(
        date_of_onset = as.Date(date_of_onset),
        recovery_date = ifelse(!is.na(date_of_onset), date_of_onset + recovery_days, NA)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(recovery_date))
    
    recovery_counts <- recovery_data %>%
      mutate(recovery_date = as.Date(recovery_date)) %>%
      group_by(recovery_date) %>%
      summarise(new_R = n()) %>%
      complete(recovery_date = dates, fill = list(new_R = 0))
    
    results$S <- NA
    results$I <- NA
    results$R <- NA
    
    results$S[1] <- N
    results$I[1] <- 0
    results$R[1] <- 0
    
    for (t in 2:length(dates)) {
      results$S[t] <- results$S[t-1] - onset_counts$new_I[t]
      results$I[t] <- results$I[t-1] + onset_counts$new_I[t] - recovery_counts$new_R[t]
      results$R[t] <- results$R[t-1] + recovery_counts$new_R[t]
    }
    
  } else if (model_type == "SEIR") {
    exposure_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(date_of_exposure = as.Date(date_of_exposure)) %>%
      group_by(date_of_exposure) %>%
      summarise(new_E = n()) %>%
      complete(date_of_exposure = dates, fill = list(new_E = 0))
    
    onset_counts <- dataset %>%
      mutate(date_of_onset = as.Date(date_of_onset)) %>%
      group_by(date_of_onset) %>%
      summarise(new_I = n()) %>%
      complete(date_of_onset = dates, fill = list(new_I = 0))
    
    recovery_data <- dataset %>%
      mutate(
        date_of_onset = as.Date(date_of_onset),
        recovery_date = ifelse(!is.na(date_of_onset), date_of_onset + recovery_days, NA)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(recovery_date))
    
    recovery_counts <- recovery_data %>%
      mutate(recovery_date = as.Date(recovery_date)) %>%
      group_by(recovery_date) %>%
      summarise(new_R = n()) %>%
      complete(recovery_date = dates, fill = list(new_R = 0))
    
    results$S <- NA
    results$E <- NA
    results$I <- NA
    results$R <- NA
    
    results$S[1] <- N
    results$E[1] <- 0
    results$I[1] <- 0
    results$R[1] <- 0
    
    for (t in 2:length(dates)) {
      results$S[t] <- results$S[t-1] - exposure_counts$new_E[t]
      results$E[t] <- results$E[t-1] + exposure_counts$new_E[t] - onset_counts$new_I[t]
      results$I[t] <- results$I[t-1] + onset_counts$new_I[t] - recovery_counts$new_R[t]
      results$R[t] <- results$R[t-1] + recovery_counts$new_R[t]
    }
  }
  
  results[,-1] <- lapply(results[,-1], function(x) pmax(0, x, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r viz-functions}
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = sir_long %>% filter(Compartment == "R", Type == "Simulated"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = "Recovered (Simulated)",

        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_title(text = "SIR Model", style = list(fontSize = "18px", fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT", fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = "Time From Epidemic Onset (Days)", style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT")),
        labels = list(format = "{value:.0f}")
      ) %>%
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of Individuals", style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT"))) %>%
      hc_tooltip(
        shared = TRUE,
        crosshairs = TRUE,
        headerFormat = "<b>Day {point.x:.0f}</b><br/>",
        pointFormat = "{series.name}: <b>{point.y:.0f}</b><br/>"

      hc_legend(itemStyle = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT")) %>%
      hc_exporting(
        enabled = TRUE,
        buttons = list(
          contextButton = list(
            menuItems = c("downloadPNG", "downloadPDF")
          )
        ),
        chartOptions = list(
          chart = list(
            backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF"
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_chart(
        backgroundColor = "#FBFBFB",
        style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT")
      )
    
    if (!simulation_only) {
      hc <- hc %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = sir_long %>% filter(Compartment == "S", Type == "Real"),
          type = "spline",
          hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
          name = "Susceptible (Real)",
          color = "#1f77b4",
          dashStyle = "Solid",
          lineWidth = 2,
          marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
        ) %>%
        hc_add_series(
          data = sir_long %>% filter(Compartment == "I", Type == "Real"),
          type = "spline",
          hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
          name = "Infected (Real)",

        ) %>%
        hc_add_series(

        )
    }
    
    return(hc)
  }
}

compartment_viz <- function(results, compartment, simulation_only = FALSE, 
                           bootstrap_ci = NULL, real_data_ci = NULL,
                           show_ci = list(ci_95 = FALSE, ci_90 = FALSE, ci_75 = FALSE, ci_50 = FALSE)) {
  if (!is.null(results$Date) && all(!is.na(results$Date)) && inherits(results$Date, "Date")) {
    min_date <- min(results$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
    results <- results %>%
      mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min_date))
  } else {
    results <- results %>%
      mutate(Days = row_number() - 1)
  }
  
  comp_colors <- c(
    "S" = "#1f77b4",
    "E" = "#a51ebd", 
    "I" = "#d62728",
    "R" = "#2ca02c"
  )
  
  comp_name <- switch(compartment,
                     "susceptible" = "S",
                     "exposed" = "E",
                     "infected" = "I",
                     "recovered" = "R")
  
  comp_title <- switch(compartment,
                      "susceptible" = "Susceptible",
                      "exposed" = "Exposed",
                      "infected" = "Infected",
                      "recovered" = "Recovered")
  
  if (simulation_only) {
    long_data <- results %>%
      select(Days, !!sym(comp_name)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(!!sym(comp_name)), names_to = "Compartment", values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = "Simulated")
  } else {
    real_col <- paste0(comp_name, "_real")
    long_data <- results %>%
      select(Days, !!sym(comp_name), !!sym(real_col)) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(!!sym(comp_name), !!sym(real_col)), names_to = "Compartment", values_to = "Count") %>%
      mutate(Type = ifelse(Compartment == comp_name, "Simulated", "Real"),
             Compartment = gsub("_real", "", Compartment))
  }
  
  hc <- highchart() %>%
    hc_title(text = paste0(comp_title, " Population"), 
             style = list(fontSize = "18px", fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT", fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
    hc_xAxis(
      title = list(text = "Time From Epidemic Onset (Days)", style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT")),
      labels = list(format = "{value:.0f}")
    ) %>%
    hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Number of Individuals", style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT"))) %>%
    hc_tooltip(
      shared = TRUE,
      crosshairs = TRUE,
      formatter = JS("
        function () {
          var points = this.points;
          var tooltip = '<b>Day ' + this.x.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
          points.forEach(function(point) {
            if (point.series.type === 'areasplinerange') {
              tooltip += point.series.name + ': <b>' + point.point.low.toFixed(0) + ' - ' + point.point.high.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
            } else {
              tooltip += point.series.name + ': <b>' + point.y.toFixed(0) + '</b><br/>';
            }
          });
          return tooltip;
        }
      ")
    ) %>%
    hc_legend(enabled = TRUE) %>%
    hc_exporting(
      enabled = TRUE,
      buttons = list(
        contextButton = list(
          menuItems = c("downloadPNG", "downloadPDF")
        )
      ),
      chartOptions = list(
        chart = list(
          backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    hc_chart(
      backgroundColor = "#FBFBFB",
      style = list(fontFamily = "Tw Cen MT")
    )
  
  main_sim <- results[[comp_name]]
  main_real <- if (!simulation_only) results[[paste0(comp_name, "_real")]] else NULL
  
  if ((input$ci_type == "Both" || input$ci_type == "Simulated Only") && !is.null(bootstrap_ci) && !simulation_only) {
    ci_data <- bootstrap_ci[[comp_name]]
    
    if (!is.null(ci_data) && "Date" %in% names(ci_data)) {
      ci_data_with_days <- ci_data %>%
        mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min(results$Date, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
        filter(Days %in% results$Days) %>%
        select(Days, starts_with("ci_"))
      
      if (nrow(ci_data_with_days) > 0 && any(!is.na(ci_data_with_days))) {
        add_ci_band <- function(hc, low_col, high_col, level, opacity) {
          band_data <- ci_data_with_days %>% 
            select(Days, low = !!sym(low_col), high = !!sym(high_col)) %>%
            filter(!is.na(low), !is.na(high), is.finite(low), is.finite(high))
          
          if (nrow(band_data) > 0) {
            span_value <- 0.5  # More conservative smoothing
            if (nrow(band_data) > 5) {
              low_loess <- tryCatch({
                loess(low ~ Days, data = band_data, span = span_value)
              }, error = function(e) {
                NULL
              })
              high_loess <- tryCatch({
                loess(high ~ Days, data = band_data, span = span_value)
              }, error = function(e) {
                NULL
              })
              
              if (!is.null(low_loess) && !is.null(high_loess)) {
                band_data$low <- predict(low_loess)
                band_data$high <- predict(high_loess)
                
                band_data$low <- pmax(0, band_data$low)
                band_data$high <- pmax(0, band_data$high)
                
                band_data$low <- pmin(band_data$low, main_sim[match(band_data$Days, results$Days)])
                band_data$high <- pmax(band_data$high, main_sim[match(band_data$Days, results$Days)])
              } else {
                band_data$low <- pmax(0, band_data$low)
                band_data$high <- pmax(0, band_data$high)
              }
            }
            
            hc %>%
              hc_add_series(
                data = list_parse(band_data),
                type = "areasplinerange",
                name = paste0(comp_title, " Simulated CI ", level, "%"),
                color = paste0("rgba(", paste(col2rgb(comp_colors[comp_name]), collapse = ","), ", ", opacity, ")"),
                fillOpacity = opacity,
                lineWidth = 0,
                marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
                zIndex = 1
              )
          } else {
            hc
          }
        }
        
        if (show_ci$ci_95) {
          hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_2.5", "ci_97.5", "95", 0.15)
        }
        if (show_ci$ci_90) {
          hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_5", "ci_95", "90", 0.25)
        }
        if (show_ci$ci_75) {
          hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_12.5", "ci_87.5", "75", 0.35)
        }
        if (show_ci$ci_50) {
          hc <- add_ci_band(hc, "ci_25", "ci_75", "50", 0.45)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if ((input$ci_type == "Both" || input$ci_type == "Real Only") && !is.null(real_data_ci) && !simulation_only) {
    tryCatch({
      comp_ci <- real_data_ci[[comp_name]]
      
      if (!is.null(comp_ci) && "Date" %in% names(comp_ci) && nrow(comp_ci) > 0) {
        if (all(!is.na(comp_ci$Date)) && inherits(comp_ci$Date, "Date")) {
          real_ci_with_days <- comp_ci %>%
            mutate(Days = as.numeric(Date - min(results$Date, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
            filter(Days %in% results$Days) %>%
            filter(complete.cases(across(starts_with("ci_"))))
          
          if (nrow(real_ci_with_days) > 0) {
            add_real_ci_band <- function(hc, low_col, high_col, level, opacity) {
              band_data <- real_ci_with_days %>% 
                select(Days, low = !!sym(low_col), high = !!sym(high_col)) %>%
                filter(!is.na(low), !is.na(high), is.finite(low), is.finite(high))
              
              if (nrow(band_data) > 0) {
                span_value <- 0.5  # More conservative smoothing
                if (nrow(band_data) > 5) {
                  low_loess <- tryCatch({
                    loess(low ~ Days, data = band_data, span = span_value)
                  }, error = function(e) {
                    NULL
                  })
                  high_loess <- tryCatch({
                    loess(high ~ Days, data = band_data, span = span_value)
                  }, error = function(e) {
                    NULL
                  })
                  
                  if (!is.null(low_loess) && !is.null(high_loess)) {
                    band_data$low <- predict(low_loess)
                    band_data$high <- predict(high_loess)
                    
                    band_data$low <- pmax(0, band_data$low)
                    band_data$high <- pmax(0, band_data$high)
                    
                    band_data$low <- pmin(band_data$low, main_real[match(band_data$Days, results$Days)])
                    band_data$high <- pmax(band_data$high, main_real[match(band_data$Days, results$Days)])
                  } else {
                    band_data$low <- pmax(0, band_data$low)
                    band_data$high <- pmax(0, band_data$high)
                  }
                }
                
                grey_value <- 100 - (as.numeric(gsub("%", "", level)) / 100 * 60)
                grey_value <- max(40, min(100, grey_value))
                
                hc %>%
                  hc_add_series(
                    data = list_parse(band_data),
                    type = "areasplinerange",
                    name = paste0(comp_title, " Real CI ", level, "%"),
                    color = paste0("rgba(", grey_value, ", ", grey_value, ", ", grey_value, ", ", opacity, ")"),
                    fillOpacity = opacity,
                    lineWidth = 0,
                    marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
                    zIndex = 0
                  )
              } else {
                hc
              }
            }
            
            if (show_ci$ci_95) {
              hc <- add_real_ci_band(hc, "ci_2.5", "ci_97.5", "95", 0.10)
            }
            if (show_ci$ci_90) {
              hc <- add_real_ci_band(hc, "ci_5", "ci_95", "90", 0.15)
            }
            if (show_ci$ci_75) {
              hc <- add_real_ci_band(hc, "ci_12.5", "ci_87.5", "75", 0.20)
            }
            if (show_ci$ci_50) {
              hc <- add_real_ci_band(hc, "ci_25", "ci_75", "50", 0.25)
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error adding real data CI for ", comp_name, ": ", e$message)
    })
  }
  
  hc <- hc %>%
    hc_add_series(
      data = long_data %>% filter(Type == "Simulated"),
      type = "spline",
      hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
      name = paste0(comp_title, " (Simulated)"),
      color = comp_colors[comp_name],
      dashStyle = "Dash",
      lineWidth = 2,
      marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
      zIndex = 5
    )
  
  if (!simulation_only) {
    hc <- hc %>%
      hc_add_series(
        data = long_data %>% filter(Type == "Real"),
        type = "spline",
        hcaes(x = Days, y = Count),
        name = paste0(comp_title, " (Real)"),
        color = comp_colors[comp_name],
        dashStyle = "Solid",
        lineWidth = 2,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE),
        zIndex = 6
      )
  }
  
  return(hc)
}
```

```{r params-functions}
custom_datatable <- function(params) {
  datatable(
    params,
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Brt',
      buttons = c('csv','excel', 'pdf'),
      pageLength = nrow(params)
    )
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      fontSize = '14px',
      fontFamily = 'Tw Cen MT'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      target = 'row',
      borderBottom = '1px solid #ddd'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(params),
      backgroundColor = 'white'
    ) 
}

si_params_table <- function(N, beta, days, results) {
  
  peak_day_sim <- results$time[which.max(results$I)]  # Get the day number where peak occurs
  peak_value_sim <- max(results$I, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_sim <- as.numeric(max(results$Date) - min(results$Date))
  final_s_sim <- tail(results$S, 1)
  final_i_sim <- tail(results$I, 1)
  
  params <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("N", "Beta", "Initial S", "Initial I",
                 "Final S", "Final I",
                 "Duration (days)", "Peak Infections", 
                 "Peak Time"), 
    Description = c(
      "Total population size",
      "Transmission rate (range: 0.1-3.0 per day)",
      "Initial susceptible population",
      "Initial infected population",
      "Final susceptible population",
      "Final infected population",
      "Duration of epidemic",
      "Peak number of infected",
      "Day of peak infection"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(N),
      as.character(round(beta, 3)),
      as.character(input$initial_S_si),
      as.character(input$initial_I_si),
      as.character(round(final_s_sim),0),
      as.character(round(final_i_sim),0),
      as.character(duration_sim),
      as.character(round(peak_value_sim),0),
      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_sim))
    )
  )
  
  custom_datatable(params)
}

sir_params_table <- function(N, beta, gamma, days, results) {
  peak_day_sim <- results$time[which.max(results$I)]
  peak_value_sim <- max(results$I, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_sim <- as.numeric(max(results$Date) - min(results$Date))
  final_s_sim <- tail(results$S, 1)
  final_i_sim <- tail(results$I, 1)
  final_r_sim <- tail(results$R, 1)
  
  params <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("N", "Beta", "Gamma", "R0", 
                 "Initial S", "Initial I", "Initial R",
                 "Final S", "Final I", "Final R",
                 "Duration (days)", "Peak Infections", 
                 "Peak Time", "Infectious Period"),
    Description = c(
      "Total population size",
      "Transmission rate (range: 0.1-3.0 per day)",
      "Recovery rate (range: 0.05-0.5 per day)",
      "Basic reproduction number (Beta/Gamma)",
      "Initial susceptible population",
      "Initial infected population",
      "Initial recovered population",
      "Final susceptible population",
      "Final infected population",
      "Final recovered population",
      "Duration of epidemic",
      "Peak number of infected",
      "Day of peak infection",
      "Average infectious period (1/Gamma)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(N),
      as.character(round(beta, 3)),
      as.character(round(gamma, 3)),
      as.character(round(beta/gamma, 3)),
      as.character(input$initial_S_sir),
      as.character(input$initial_I_sir),
      as.character(input$initial_R_sir),
      as.character(round(final_s_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_i_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_r_sim)),
      as.character(duration_sim),
      as.character(round(peak_value_sim)),
      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_sim)),
      as.character(round(1/gamma, 1))
    )
  )
  
  custom_datatable(params)
}

seir_params_table <- function(N, beta, sigma, gamma, days, results) {
  peak_day_sim <- results$time[which.max(results$I)]  # Get the day number where peak occurs
  peak_value_sim <- max(results$I, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_sim <- as.numeric(max(results$Date) - min(results$Date))
  final_s_sim <- tail(results$S, 1)
  final_e_sim <- tail(results$E, 1)
  final_i_sim <- tail(results$I, 1)
  final_r_sim <- tail(results$R, 1)
  
  params <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("N", "Beta", "Sigma", "Gamma", "R0",
                 "Initial S", "Initial E", "Initial I", "Initial R",
                 "Final S", "Final E", "Final I", "Final R",
                 "Duration (days)", "Peak Infections", 
                 "Peak Time", "Incubation Period", "Infectious Period"),
    Description = c(
      "Total population size",
      "Transmission rate (range: 0.1-3.0 per day)",
      "Exposure rate (range: 0.1-1.0 per day)",
      "Recovery rate (range: 0.05-0.5 per day)",
      "Basic reproduction number (Beta/Gamma)",
      "Initial susceptible population",
      "Initial exposed population",
      "Initial infected population",
      "Initial recovered population",
      "Final susceptible population",
      "Final exposed population",
      "Final infected population",
      "Final recovered population",
      "Duration of epidemic",
      "Peak number of infected",
      "Day of peak infection",
      "Average incubation period (1/Sigma)",
      "Average infectious period (1/Gamma)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(N),
      as.character(round(beta, 3)),
      as.character(round(sigma, 3)),
      as.character(round(gamma, 3)),
      as.character(round(beta/gamma, 3)),
      as.character(input$initial_S_seir),
      as.character(input$initial_E_seir),
      as.character(input$initial_I_seir),
      as.character(input$initial_R_seir),
      as.character(round(final_s_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_e_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_i_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_r_sim)),
      as.character(duration_sim),
      as.character(round(peak_value_sim)),
      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_sim)),
      as.character(round(1/sigma, 1)),
      as.character(round(1/gamma, 1))
    )
  )
  
  custom_datatable(params)
}

real_si_params_table <- function(dataset, beta, results, N_override = NULL) {
  N <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override else nrow(dataset)
  peak_day_sim <- results$time[which.max(results$I)] 
  peak_value_sim <- max(results$I, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_sim <- as.numeric(max(results$Date) - min(results$Date))
  final_s_sim <- tail(results$S, 1)
  final_i_sim <- tail(results$I, 1)
  
  peak_day_real <- results$time[which.max(results$I_real)]
  peak_value_real <- max(results$I_real, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_real <- as.numeric(max(results$Date[!is.na(results$I_real)]) - 
                   min(results$Date[!is.na(results$I_real)]))
  final_s_real <- tail(results$S_real[!is.na(results$S_real)], 1)
  final_i_real <- tail(results$I_real[!is.na(results$I_real)], 1)
  
  # Calculate infections saved if N was overridden
  infections_saved <- if (!is.null(N_override)) N_override - nrow(dataset) else NA
  
  params <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("N", "Beta", "Initial S (Simulated)", "Initial I (Simulated)",
                 "Final S (Simulated)", "Final I (Simulated)",
                 "Initial S (Real)", "Initial I (Real)",
                 "Final S (Real)", "Final I (Real)",
                 "Simulated Duration (days)", "Simulated Peak", 
                 "Simulated Peak Day", "Real Duration (days)", 
                 "Real Peak", "Real Peak Day"),
    Description = c(
      "Total population size",
      "Transmission rate (range: 0.1-3.0 per day)",
      "Initial susceptible population (simulated)",
      "Initial infected population (simulated)",
      "Final susceptible population (simulated)",
      "Final infected population (simulated)",
      "Initial susceptible population (real)",
      "Initial infected population (real)",
      "Final susceptible population (real)",
      "Final infected population (real)",
      "Duration of epidemic (simulated)",
      "Peak number of infected (simulated)",
      "Day of peak infection (simulated)",
      "Duration of epidemic (real)",
      "Peak number of infected (real)",
      "Day of peak infection (real)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(N),
      as.character(round(beta, 3)),
      as.character(N - 1),
      "1",
      as.character(round(final_s_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_i_sim)),
      as.character(N),
      "0",
      as.character(round(final_s_real)),
      as.character(round(final_i_real)),
      as.character(duration_sim),
      as.character(round(peak_value_sim)),
      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_sim)),
      as.character(duration_real),
      as.character(round(peak_value_real)),
      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_real))
    )
  )
  
  # add infections saved row if applicable
  if (!is.na(infections_saved)) {
    infections_row <- data.frame(
      Parameter = "Total Infections Saved",
      Description = "Estimated infections prevented compared to baseline",
      Value = as.character(round(infections_saved))
    )
    params <- rbind(params, infections_row)
  }
  
  custom_datatable(params)
}

  peak_value_sim <- max(results$I, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_sim <- as.numeric(max(results$Date) - min(results$Date))
  final_s_sim <- tail(results$S, 1)
  final_e_sim <- tail(results$E, 1)
  final_i_sim <- tail(results$I, 1)
  final_r_sim <- tail(results$R, 1)
  
  peak_day_real <- results$time[which.max(results$I_real)]
  peak_value_real <- max(results$I_real, na.rm = TRUE)
  duration_real <- as.numeric(max(results$Date[!is.na(results$I_real)]) - 
                             min(results$Date[!is.na(results$I_real)]))
  final_s_real <- tail(results$S_real[!is.na(results$S_real)], 1)

                 "Final S (Real)", "Final E (Real)", "Final I (Real)", "Final R (Real)",
                 "Incubation Period", "Infectious Period", "Simulated Duration (days)",

      "Exposure rate (range: 0.1-1.0 per day)",
      "Recovery rate (range: 0.05-0.5 per day)",

      "Initial susceptible population (simulated)",
      "Initial exposed population (simulated)",
      "Initial infected population (simulated)",

      "Final infected population (simulated)",
      "Final recovered population (simulated)",
      "Initial susceptible population (real)",
      "Initial exposed population (real)",
      "Initial infected population (real)",
      "Initial recovered population (real)",
      "Final susceptible population (real)",
      "Final exposed population (real)",
      "Final infected population (real)",
      "Final recovered population (real)",
      "Time from exposure to onset (days)",
      "Time from onset to recovery (days)",
      "Duration of epidemic (simulated)",
      "Peak number of infected (simulated)",
      "Day of peak infection (simulated)", 
      "Duration of epidemic (real)",
      "Peak number of infected (real)",
      "Day of peak infection (real)" 
    ),
    Value = c(
      as.character(N),
      as.character(round(beta, 3)),
      as.character(round(sigma, 3)),
      as.character(round(gamma, 3)),
      as.character(round(beta/gamma, 3)),
      as.character(N - 1),
      "0",
      "1",
      "0",
      as.character(round(final_s_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_e_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_i_sim)),
      as.character(round(final_r_sim)),
      as.character(N),
      "0",
      "0",
      "0",
      as.character(round(final_s_real)),
      as.character(round(final_e_real)),
      as.character(round(final_i_real)),
      as.character(round(final_r_real)),
      ifelse(length(incubation_days) > 0,
             paste0("Mean: ", round(mean(incubation_days)), 
                   " days (range ", min(incubation_days), "-", 
                   max(incubation_days), ")"),

      as.character(round(1/gamma, 1)),

      paste0("Day ", as.character(peak_day_sim)),
      as.character(duration_real),

      Parameter = "Total Infections Saved",
      Description = "Estimated infections prevented compared to baseline",
```

```{r create-and-render-demographic-summary}

create_demographic_summary <- function(df, var_name) {
  if (var_name == "age_group") {
    df <- df %>% mutate(age_group = as.numeric(as.character(age_group)))
    summary_df <- df %>%
      summarise(
        N = n(),
        Mean = round(mean(age_group, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        SD = round(sd(age_group, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        Median = median(age_group, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = min(age_group, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = max(age_group, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  } else {
    df <- df %>% mutate(!!var_name := as.factor(as.character(.data[[var_name]])))
    summary_df <- df %>%
      group_by(.data[[var_name]]) %>%
      summarise(Count = n()) %>%
      mutate(Percentage = Count / sum(Count)) %>%
      rename(Category = 1)
  }
  return(summary_df)
}

render_demographic_table <- function(summary_df) {
  if ("Mean" %in% names(summary_df)) {
    datatable(
      summary_df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(
        dom = 't',
        pageLength = nrow(summary_df)
      )
    ) %>%
      formatStyle(
        columns = 1:ncol(summary_df),
        fontSize = '14px',
        fontFamily = 'Tw Cen MT'
      ) %>%
      formatRound(columns = c("Mean", "SD"), digits = 2)
  } else {
    datatable(
      summary_df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options = list(
        dom = 't',
        pageLength = nrow(summary_df)
      )
    ) %>%
      formatStyle(
        columns = 1:ncol(summary_df),
        fontSize = '14px',
        fontFamily = 'Tw Cen MT'
      ) %>%
      formatPercentage('Percentage', 1)
  }
}
```

```{r app-observers}
useShinyjs()

observeEvent(list(
  input$model, input$N, input$days, input$simulation_only, input$custom_N, input$N_real,
  input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma,
  input$initial_S_si, input$initial_I_si,
  input$initial_S_sir, input$initial_I_sir, input$initial_R_sir,
  input$initial_S_seir, input$initial_E_seir, input$initial_I_seir, input$initial_R_seir,
  input$file1
), {
  params_changed(TRUE)
})

observe({
  req(input$model)
  
  current_N <- if (simulation_only()) {
    input$N
  } else {
    if (!is.null(dataset()) && input$custom_N) {
      input$N_real
    } else if (!is.null(dataset())) {
      nrow(dataset())
    } else {
      return()
    }
  }
  
  req(current_N, is.numeric(current_N))
  
  if (input$model == "SI") {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_si", value = current_N - 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_si", value = 1)
  } else if (input$model == "SIR") {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_sir", value = current_N - 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_sir", value = 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_sir", value = 0)
  } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_seir", value = current_N - 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_E_seir", value = 0)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_seir", value = 1)
    updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_seir", value = 0)
  }
})

observe({
  req(input$custom_N, input$N_real, !simulation_only(), dataset())
  
  req_n <- nrow(dataset()) + 1
  current_n <- input$N_real
  
  if (current_n < req_n) {
    shinyjs::disable("run_model")
    showNotification(
      paste0("Your file contains ", nrow(dataset()), " cases; choose N ≥ ", req_n),
      type = "error",
      duration = 10
    )
  } else {
    shinyjs::enable("run_model")
  }
})

observeEvent(dataset(), {
  if (!is.null(dataset()) && !simulation_only()) {
    updateSliderInput(session, "N_real", value = nrow(dataset()))
  }
})

observeEvent(input$run_model, {
  withProgress(message = 'Running model...', value = 0, {
    params_changed(FALSE)

    tryCatch({
      req(input$model)

      run_clicked(TRUE)

      if (simulation_only()) {
        req(input$N)
        current_N <- input$N
        N_override <- NULL
      } else {
        req(dataset())
        if (input$custom_N) {
          req(input$N_real)
          current_N <- input$N_real
          N_override <- current_N
        } else {
          current_N <- nrow(dataset())
          N_override <- NULL
        }
      }

      current_S <- if (input$model == "SI") input$initial_S_si else
                  if (input$model == "SIR") input$initial_S_sir else
                  input$initial_S_seir

      current_I <- if (input$model == "SI") input$initial_I_si else
                  if (input$model == "SIR") input$initial_I_sir else
                  input$initial_I_seir

      current_E <- if (input$model %in% c("SI", "SIR")) 0 else input$initial_E_seir
      current_R <- if (input$model == "SI") 0 else
                  if (input$model == "SIR") input$initial_R_sir else
                  input$initial_R_seir

      sum_compartments <- current_S + current_I + current_E + current_R

      if (sum_compartments != current_N) {
        showNotification(
          paste("Error: Initial compartments must sum to N (", current_N,
                "). Current sum: ", sum_compartments,
                ". Resetting to defaults (i.e. S = N - 1, I = 1 , E = 0, R = 0)."),
          type = "error",
          duration = 10
        )

        if (input$model == "SI") {
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_si", value = current_N - 1)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_si", value = 1)
        } else if (input$model == "SIR") {
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_sir", value = current_N - 1)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_sir", value = 1)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_sir", value = 0)
        } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_S_seir", value = current_N - 1)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_E_seir", value = 0)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_I_seir", value = 1)
          updateNumericInput(session, "initial_R_seir", value = 0)
        }
        
        return()
      }

      shinyjs::removeClass(id = if (input$model == "SI") "initial_S_si" else
                          if (input$model == "SIR") "initial_S_sir" else "initial_S_seir",
                          class = "error-highlight")
      shinyjs::removeClass(id = if (input$model == "SI") "initial_I_si" else
                          if (input$model == "SIR") "initial_I_sir" else "initial_I_seir",
                          class = "error-highlight")
      if (input$model == "SIR") {
        shinyjs::removeClass("initial_R_sir", "error-highlight")
      } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
        shinyjs::removeClass("initial_E_seir", "error-highlight")
        shinyjs::removeClass("initial_R_seir", "error-highlight")
      }

      req(input$beta)

      if (simulation_only()) {
        req(input$days)
      }

      if (input$model == "SEIR") {
        req(input$sigma, input$gamma)
      }

      if (input$model == "SIR") {
        req(input$gamma)
      }

      incProgress(0.3, detail = "Computing model...")

      if (simulation_only()) {
        if (input$model == "SI") {
          results <- run_si_model(current_N, input$beta, input$days,
                                current_S, current_I)
        } else if (input$model == "SIR") {
          results <- run_sir_model(current_N, input$beta, input$gamma, input$days,
                                 current_S, current_I, current_R)
        } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
          results <- run_seir_model(current_N, input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, input$days,
                                  current_S, current_E, current_I, current_R)
        }
        bootstrap_results(NULL)
        real_data_ci(NULL)
      } else {
        req(dataset())
        df <- dataset()

        if (input$model == "SI") {
          results <- run_real_model(df, "SI", input$beta, N_override = N_override)
        } else if (input$model == "SIR") {
          results <- run_real_model(df, "SIR", input$beta, gamma = input$gamma, N_override = N_override)
        } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
          results <- run_real_model(df, "SEIR", input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, N_override = N_override)
        }
        
        incProgress(0.3, detail = "Computing confidence intervals...")

        tryCatch({
          if (input$model == "SI") {
            bootstrap_ci <- run_bayesian_bootstrap_ci(df, "SI", input$beta, 
                                                     sigma = NULL, 
                                                     gamma = NULL,
                                                     n_boot = 10,
                                                     N_override = N_override)
          } else if (input$model == "SIR") {
            bootstrap_ci <- run_bayesian_bootstrap_ci(df, "SIR", input$beta, 
                                                     sigma = NULL,
                                                     gamma = input$gamma,
                                                     n_boot = 10,
                                                     N_override = N_override)
          } else if (input$model == "SEIR") {
            bootstrap_ci <- run_bayesian_bootstrap_ci(df, "SEIR", input$beta, 
                                                     sigma = input$sigma,
                                                     gamma = input$gamma,
                                                     n_boot = 10,
                                                     N_override = N_override)
          }
          bootstrap_results(bootstrap_ci)
        }, error = function(e) {
          showNotification(
            paste("Error running Bayesian bootstrap for simulated data: ", e$message),
            type = "warning",
            duration = 10
          )
          bootstrap_results(NULL)
        })
        
        tryCatch({
          if (input$model == "SI") {
            real_ci <- run_real_data_ci(df, input$model, n_boot = 10, N_override = N_override)
          } else {
            real_ci <- run_real_data_ci(df, input$model, n_boot = 10, N_override = N_override, gamma = input$gamma)
          }
          if (!is.null(real_ci)) {
            real_data_ci(real_ci)
          } else {
            real_data_ci(NULL)
            showNotification("Could not generate confidence intervals for real data. Check if your dataset has valid date columns.", type = "warning", duration = 10)
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          real_data_ci(NULL)
          showNotification(paste("Error generating real data CI:", e$message), type = "warning", duration = 10)
        })
      }

      if (!is.null(results)) {
        model_results(results)
        current_model(input$model)
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(
        paste("Error running model: Confirm that all parameters are properly set", e$message),
        type = "error",
        duration = 10
      )
    })
  })
})

observeEvent(input$simulation_only, {
  previous_mode(simulation_only())
  simulation_only(input$simulation_only)
  run_clicked(FALSE)
  bootstrap_results(NULL)
  if (!input$simulation_only && is.null(input$file1)) {
    showNotification("Please upload a dataset when comparing with real data", type = "message", duration = 10)
  }
})
```

```{r get-demo-cols}
observe({
  req(dataset())
  df <- dataset()
  
  # get all column names
  all_cols <- names(df)
  
  # exclude unwanted columns like columns containing 'date' and columns named 'id' or 'x1'
  demo_cols <- all_cols[!grepl("date", all_cols, ignore.case = TRUE) & 
                        !tolower(all_cols) %in% c("id", "x1", "v1")]
  
  # update the selectize input
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "demo_vars", 
                      choices = sort(demo_cols),
                      selected = ifelse("sex" %in% demo_cols, "sex", demo_cols[1]))
})
```

### Model Visualization

```{r render-model-viz}

model_results <- reactiveVal(NULL)
current_model <- reactiveVal(NULL)
separate_plots <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
simulation_only <- reactiveVal(TRUE)

# initialize with proper values
observe({
  separate_plots(isolate(input$separate_plots))
  simulation_only(isolate(input$simulation_only))
})

# New: Reactive for CI settings
ci_settings <- reactive({
  list(
    ci_95 = input$ci_95,
    ci_90 = input$ci_90,
    ci_75 = input$ci_75,
    ci_50 = input$ci_50
  )
})

# render combined plot
output$model_viz <- renderHighchart({
  req(model_results(), current_model(), !params_changed())
  
  results <- model_results()
  
  if (current_model() == "SI") {
    si_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  } else if (current_model() == "SIR") {
    sir_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  } else if (current_model() == "SEIR") {
    seir_viz(results, separate = FALSE, simulation_only = simulation_only())
  }
})


output$compartment_plot <- renderHighchart({
  req(model_results(), current_model(), input$separate_plots, input$compartment, !params_changed())
  
  results <- model_results()
  
  compartment_viz(
    results = results,
    compartment = input$compartment,
    simulation_only = simulation_only(),
    bootstrap_ci = if (!simulation_only()) bootstrap_results() else NULL,
    real_data_ci = if (!simulation_only()) real_data_ci() else NULL,
    show_ci = ci_settings()
  )
})

# update separate_plots reactive value without recomputing model
observeEvent(input$separate_plots, {
  if (!is.null(model_results()) && !is.null(current_model()) && current_model() == input$model) {
    separate_plots(input$separate_plots)
  }
})

# renderUI
renderUI({
  # Check if mode has changed by comparing current and previous simulation_only state
  mode_changed <- !is.null(previous_mode()) && previous_mode() != simulation_only()
  
  if (is.null(model_results()) || is.null(current_model()) || !run_clicked()) {
    if (mode_changed) {
      if (simulation_only()) {
        return(div(
          p("Welcome to Simulated Only mode! Adjust parameters and click 'Run Model Simulation' to visualize results.",
            style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
        ))
      } else {
        return(div(
          p("Welcome to Real vs Simulated mode! Upload a dataset, adjust parameters, and click 'Run Model Simulation' to compare results.",
            style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
        ))
      }
    } else {
      return(div(
        p("Welcome to SEIRify! Choose 'Simulated Scenario Only' mode (toggle on) or 'Real vs. Simulated' mode (toggle off, upload a dataset). Pick a model, set parameters, and click 'Run Model Simulation' to see results.",
          style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
      ))
    }
  } else if (params_changed()) {
    return(div(
      p("Parameters updated. Click 'Run Model Simulation' to view new results.",
        style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
    ))
  }
  
  if (input$separate_plots) {
    div(
      style = "height: 450px; width: 100%;",
      highchartOutput("compartment_plot")
    )
  } else {
    highchartOutput("model_viz")
  }
})
```

### Model Parameters

```{r render-params-table}

output$params_table <- renderDT({
  req(run_clicked(), model_results(), current_model(), !params_changed())
  
  results <- model_results()
  
  if (simulation_only()) {
    if (current_model() == "SI") {
      si_params_table(input$N, input$beta, input$days, results)
    } else if (current_model() == "SIR") {
      sir_params_table(input$N, input$beta, input$gamma, input$days, results)
    } else if (current_model() == "SEIR") {
      seir_params_table(input$N, input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, input$days, results)
    }
  } else {
    req(dataset())
    df <- dataset()
    
    # Get N value for real data mode
    N_val <- if (input$custom_N) input$N_real else NULL
    
    if (current_model() == "SI") {
      real_si_params_table(df, input$beta, results, N_override = N_val)
    } else if (current_model() == "SIR") {
      real_sir_params_table(df, input$beta, input$gamma, results, N_override = N_val)
    } else if (current_model() == "SEIR") {
      real_seir_params_table(df, input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, results, N_override = N_val)
    }
  }
})

renderUI({
  if (!run_clicked()) {
    p("...",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else if (params_changed()) {
    p("Parameters updated. Click 'Run Model Simulation' to view new results.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")

    DTOutput("params_table")

})
```

### Comparison

```{r render-comparison-table}

output$comparison_table <- renderDT({
  req(run_clicked(), model_results(), current_model(), dataset(), !simulation_only(), !params_changed())
  
  df <- dataset()
  
  if (current_model() == "SI") {
    comp <- bootstrap_comparison(df, "SI", input$beta, n_boot = 10)
  } else if (current_model() == "SIR") {
    comp <- bootstrap_comparison(df, "SIR", input$beta, gamma = input$gamma, n_boot = 10)
  } else if (current_model() == "SEIR") {
    comp <- bootstrap_comparison(df, "SEIR", input$beta, input$sigma, input$gamma, n_boot = 10)
  }
  
  datatable(
    comp,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(
      dom = 'Brt',
      buttons = c('csv','excel', 'pdf'),
      pageLength = nrow(comp)
    )
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      fontSize = '14px',
      fontFamily = 'Tw Cen MT'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      target = 'row',
      borderBottom = '1px solid #ddd'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      columns = 1:ncol(comp),
      backgroundColor = 'white'
    ) %>%
    formatStyle(
      'Metric',
      fontWeight = 'bold'
    ) %>%
    formatRound(columns = c("Estimate", "Lower_CI", "Upper_CI"), digits = 0)
})

renderUI({
  if (!run_clicked()) {
    p("...",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else if (params_changed()) {
    p("Parameters updated. Click 'Run Model Simulation' to view new results.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else if (simulation_only()) {
    p("Comparison metrics are only available when comparing simulated and real scenarios.",
      style = "font-family: 'Tw Cen MT'; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;")
  } else {
    DTOutput("comparison_table")
  }
})
```
